entity: US for-profit nursing homes whose operating companies formed 2022 to Sept 2024: star ratings vs same-state for-profit peers
why: ASPE, Skilled Nursing News and Ryskina/Penn LDI find homes that change hands rate lower (same direction), but they measure pre-sale ratings or a before/after dip of about 0.1, not a current peer gap for a 2022-2024 cohort. Different definition and window, so our 0.28 can't be lined up; the Boston Globe covers only specific RI homes.
